description: Retrieve complete user travel history and booking records. Shows all past and upcoming reservations across flights, hotels, buses, and car rentals with booking details, status, and travel patterns. Reads the user's own Enuygun data through their connected account and changes nothing; share it only with that user. Use when the user asks for their trips across flights, hotels, buses and car rentals.

travel_type.description: Type of travel records to retrieve: 'flight' for flights, 'hotel' for accommodations, 'bus' for bus tickets, 'car-rent' for car rentals, or 'all' for complete travel history

name: get_user_travels
title: My Enuygun travels
